entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Yeah, Charlie, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. It's a piece of junk and I'm done with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is... uh... 9875543. Look, just process the return. I don't have time for a runaround.

Thank you, Sam. I've pulled up your account. I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker on December 31st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

It's not a 'preference matter'! The whole thing is incredibly hard to use. The menu is a disaster and the heart rate tracking is all over the place. I've read the user manual front to back and it's useless.

I understand your frustration. The interface can take a little getting used to. For the heart rate, are you making sure the band is snug against your wrist, about two finger-widths above your wrist bone?

Are you kidding me? I'm not an idiot. I've worn watches my whole life. The whole interface is just confusing, and frankly, I expected more for the price. I don't want troubleshooting, I want my money back. Get me your manager if you can't do it.
My manager would have the same information as I do, Sam. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
This is ridiculous. If I don't get a return label in my email in the next ten minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. VeloFit will regret this.

Okay, Sam, I'm checking our knowledge base now... alright. It looks like our policy states that items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Since you received it 21 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the window.
Well, finally. See? Was that so hard?

My apologies for the delay. I've just initiated the return process for you. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the VeloBand back to us. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Okay. Good. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
